The scanner ships built-in programmable-surface patterns; 'target_surfaces' here EXTENDS them (same schema: pattern/category/no_auth/persistent/public_read/notes). 'agent_contact_surfaces' extends the built-in prior-agent-contact list. _comment_sandbox_research: 2026-10-14 sandbox fingerprint research: commercial sandboxes (E2B, Modal, Daytona) have NO viable network-identity fingerprint. E2B supports BYOP SOCKS5 egress (operator-chosen IPs), Daytona egress is dynamic (static IPs are an unshipped proposal), all egress from shared cloud IPs. The hysandbox-ats case was exceptional (custom proxy label + self-reported Via + Tencent IPs + cert). Detection stays behavioral (urlquery tradecraft, webhook creator IPs), not network-identity.

jina.note: Lane 9. Jina AI reader (r.jina.ai) text extraction. Targets are URLs fetched through the reader proxy; extracted text is scanned for IOC patterns (webhook UUIDs, ntfy topics, tag grammars, b64 runs). Free tier is rate-limited: 10s spacing, 60/120s backoff on 429. Newness = content-hash dedup, not time window.
